name: How long does it take to convert a garage into a rental unit?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to convert a garage into a rental unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for converting a garage into a rental unit can range from a few months to over six months, depending on several factors. Design and permitting can take 1-3 months, while the construction phase itself typically lasts 2-4 months. The project's complexity, availability of materials, efficiency of the permitting office, and the scope of work significantly influence the duration. Hiring an experienced general contractor can help streamline the process and manage expectations regarding project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion typically takes 3-7 months, with 1-3 months for design and permitting, and 2-4 months for construction, depending on complexity and material availability.
